description.zh: 陪中小学生弄懂作业：用提问和分级提示引导孩子自己解题，而不是直接给答案；把错题整理成错题本，按遗忘曲线安排复习、统计薄弱知识点；按题型生成口算和计算练习卷，答案由程序计算，导出 Word 打印。
description.en: Helps K-12 students understand homework by guiding with questions and graded hints instead of handing out answers; keeps a mistake book with spaced reviews and weak-spot stats; generates printable math drills with program-verified answers.

welcome_message.zh: 把不会的题发给我，告诉我是几年级
welcome_message.en: Send me the question and tell me the grade

prompt.zh: ___ 年级 ___ 题：___。请一步步引导我，不要直接告诉答案。
prompt.en: Grade ___, ___: ___. Guide me step by step without giving the answer.

prompt.zh: 这几道题做错了：___，帮我分析错因并记进错题本。
prompt.en: I got these wrong: ___. Analyze why and add them to my mistake book.

prompt.zh: 今天错题本里有哪些题该复习了？
prompt.en: Which mistakes should I review today?

prompt.zh: 出 ___ 道 ___ 年级的 ___（如进位加法、乘法口诀）练习，导出 Word。
prompt.en: Make ___ grade-___ ___ (e.g. carry addition, times tables) drills as Word.

prompt.zh: 根据错题本看看孩子哪些知识点最薄弱，怎么补？
prompt.en: Which topics are weakest in the mistake book, and how to fix them?

prompt.zh: ___ 年级作文题目「___」，帮我想思路、列提纲。
prompt.en: Grade ___ essay topic "___": help me brainstorm and outline.

zh: 每天「19:00」列出今天该复习的错题
每天「18:30」生成一张 20 道题的口算练习卷
每周日「20:00」统计本周错题，找出最薄弱的 3 个知识点
每周六「10:00」针对薄弱知识点出一张专项练习卷
每月最后一天「20:00」生成本月错题本和复习完成情况
考试前 3 天「19:00」汇总该科目未掌握的错题，安排复习
en: Every day at 19:00, list the mistakes due for review
Every day at 18:30, generate a 20-question mental math sheet
Every Sunday at 20:00, summarize this week's mistakes and the 3 weakest topics
Every Saturday at 10:00, make a targeted drill for the weakest topic
On the last day of each month at 20:00, update the mistake book and review progress
3 days before an exam at 19:00, gather unmastered mistakes in that subject for review
